vehicles: Nissan Patrol GU V Wagon 3.0 TDI / ZD30CRD

flash_memory_map.full_flash: ~2 MB total (approx 1 MB flash + 2 KB EEPROM for adaptations/immobiliser)
flash_memory_map.calibration_region: Separate working calibration file available in reference

checksum.description: Multi-region 16-bit sum-to-zero checksum across 2MB flash (6 example regions covering boot, program, cal blocks for IQ/boost/timing/EGR). Auto-detect by BIN size. validate + correct functions fully implemented and exposed to UI. Correction patches CS values so sum == 0 per region. Example regions provided — refine exact offsets using your working bin or community checksum finder for 100% precision on edits.
checksum.notes: Fully implemented in checksum.rs + lib.rs + UI (validate button + auto-correct on patch). Works alongside P01. Load your .bin to test — report shows per-region status. For production tunes, verify with known-good working file after edits.

security_access.reference: Code for Device.md + planned edc16_seedkey.rs (similar to security.rs for P01)

maps_and_xdf.description: No ready XDF in reference. Requires WinOLS export or manual reverse engineering of diesel maps from the working bin. Key maps: Driver Wish (torque request map), Injection Quantity (IQ) vs speed/torque, Boost setpoint, Rail pressure, VGT duty, EGR maps, Smoke limit, Timing. (Auto tables partial support added)
maps_and_xdf.eeprom: EDC16C41 working eeprom (2 KB) - immobiliser, adaptations, coding data

notes: Matches and expands the REFERENCE_INDEX.md entry. 23710-VS43B is the specific hardware/part for GU V Wagon variant. DB entry enables auto-identification. Rust support added: CAN (ELM/ISO-TP), KWP2000, Nissan Consult II for live data + commands. Use protocol selector in UI. **Checksum validation fully implemented** for safe map editing and flashing on this ECU.
